findings.finding: DEPS/native bases agree with A0 and native row order: U=(z0,q,R0,const), three RC E/u pairs and H=(uh,Eh). Each upper-triangle pair is retained once; nodal values select its dependency union. Sequential axis inverse-Vandermonde transforms match product/ravel order. All78 cross entries remain.

Mask sum(multi_index)<=2 retains total Chebyshev degree2 from each tensor interpolant. Linear projection permits projection of each increment before addition, up to rounding. Dropped terms cannot be recovered. Separate dense nodal endpoint state/interpolation is not sparsified. Counts264/640/367 agree with2112/5120/2936 coefficient bytes.

advance requires current count/source identity, uses new rows only, carries exact nodal physical response state/charge extrema, and adds chunk Gram/noise once. No prior/posterior or plant truth enters accumulator, centering or corrections. State and coefficients are staged before ordinary synchronous numerical failures. Asynchronous/concurrent atomicity is not established.

Candidate derivatives are with respect to normalized log shapes (halfwidth1), matching runner chart_shape_jacobian and direct F@D propagation. Endpoint has correct E/u and Eh/uh order and is separate interpolation, not posterior transport. Amplitude Hessian is compared at fixed shape; full joint second shape derivatives are not reported.

Entrywise interpolation/truncation does not preserve sum-of-squares form. Active-load probes show material negative scaled amplitude eigenvalues in all3 candidates plus large NLL defects. Small rest/H7 negative eigenvalues near null directions must not be conflated with these material failures. Do not clip, call posteriors, or use these in solvers requiring positive precision.

Public prior sets query centers/amplitudes and fixed seed sets interior points. Original rejected candidate is separately outcome-selected, never training input, and computationally refused. Embedded35520 digest matches. Sources/binaries are bound by hashes. Direct independent physical C implementation uses the same finite stream; it is not exact real arithmetic.

Storage counts retained NumPy payload and major bounded scratch, not peak allocation or target SRAM. Implementation forms full lifted Gram before selecting dependency-union entries; full Gram scratch is charged. Temporary projection/query arrays, objects, libraries and platform costs remain explicitly additional. Host CPU is not M23 WCET;52-probe direct timing is not an estimator speed comparison.

Six meaningful regression tests plus reviewer full-grid and derivative probes suffice for narrow finite feasibility. They do not prove continuous-domain error, adversarial numerical stability, physical-path enclosure, aging/migration, lifetime coverage, reset behavior or target resources.
